description: This file defines a mock class 'MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator' for unit testing, implementing the 'INetworkManager::IInterfaceDetailsIterator' interface with mocked methods using Google Mock. It is used within the network management module to facilitate testing of components that depend on network interface iteration.

classes.name: MockIInterfaceDetailsIterator
classes.description: Mock implementation of INetworkManager::IInterfaceDetailsIterator for unit testing.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Moves to the next network interface detail and outputs it.

methods.name: Previous
methods.description: Moves to the previous network interface detail and outputs it.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the iterator to a given position.

methods.name: IsValid
methods.description: Checks if the current iterator position is valid.

methods.name: Count
methods.description: Returns the total number of interface details.

methods.name: Current
methods.description: Returns the current interface detail the iterator points to.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Returns a pointer to the queried interface.
